title: Snotty Nose Rez Kids - I'M GOOD
htmlContent:
"I'M GOOD" is Snotty Nose Rez Kids' latest single. The Canadian Hip-Hop duo artist Snotty Nose Rez Kids returned with a solid track to showcase their confidence just after releasing an album called "Life After" in 2021, the duo wrote I'M GOOD to reflect their optimism and confidence.

Snotty Nose Rez Kids' "I'M GOOD" is a level of music that showcases their must-hear sound to the fullest. The energy and vibes of the record are something one listens to and will never be enough for, with each passing second of the record, making you fall in love with the music more and more.
